bio: The perfect example of a traditional Baden inn! This family-run establishment has been welcoming guests since 1764, offering a consistently enjoyable experience. Behind its old half-timbered walls, there are charming dining areas – some more traditional, others more modern. In a warm and welcoming atmosphere, diners tuck into delicious regional fare. Options include classic dishes, daily specials and set menus. Tip: There is a fantastic selection of digestifs. Overnight accommodation available....
